title: HUD Theme
description: Visual theme applied to the in-game HUD. Defines colors, font, geometry, and decorative slots. See game/agent-docs/hud-theming.md for the agent-facing guide.

name.description: Human-readable theme name. Shown in UIs; not used as an identifier.

elements.description: Per-element overrides keyed by element id. Each value is a partial theme that takes precedence over the global tokens for that element only.

icons.description: Custom icon SVGs that replace the engine's built-in heart / mouse / arrow icons. Each value is inline SVG markup (≤16kb). SVGs may use currentColor or `__primary__`/`__danger__`/etc. tokens.

heart.description: Health label icon. Defaults to a filled heart.

mouse.description: Pointer-lock overlay icon. Defaults to an outlined mouse.

arrow.description: Movement-key arrow used in the controls overlay. ONE SVG — CSS rotates it for down/left/right. Defaults to a thin chevron-arrow pointing up.

fontKey.description: Curated font key from the engine font catalog. Each key maps to exactly one Google Font; published games load only the active theme's font.

case.description: Casing for label-voice text (buttons, headings, badges). Body copy is always sentence-case.

trackingLabel.description: Letter-spacing in px for label-voice text. Higher = more spaced-out / branded feel.

outlineWidth.description: Text outline width in px for display-scale text (play button, counters, timers, toasts), drawn in colors.outline. Keep ≤2; 0 = no outline. Avoid on pixel fonts.

sizeScale.description: Relative text size multiplier applied to every themed font-size. Omit for no rescaling — useful for narrow faces with no weight axis.

primary.description: Accent color: progress fills, active states, primary highlights. Must have ≥3:1 contrast against background.

background.description: Outermost HUD surface (the recessed canvas under elements).

surface.description: Element fill (cards, bar tracks, button backgrounds).

text.description: Primary text on HUD surfaces. Must have ≥4.5:1 contrast against background.

outline.description: Outline color for shape.borderWidth borders and font.outlineWidth text strokes (chunky cartoon frames, gold trim). Omit if the theme has no outline concept.

radiusPill.description: Pill / button corner radius. 500 = full pill (Bitmagic default); 0 = sharp (retro/horror).

glow.description: Aura color for selected / active / celebratory states.

imageRendering.description: Set 'pixelated' for retro / 8-bit themes that use small bitmap decorations.

borderWidth.description: Border width in px drawn in colors.outline around buttons, bars, counters, timers, toasts. Follows the theme radius (unlike border-image decorations). 0 = keep element defaults.

bevel.description: 3D bevel strength: white-top/dark-bottom edge-light gradient over buttons and fills (cartoon/candy look). 0 = flat.

gloss.description: Specular sheen strength: a soft white highlight band across the upper face of buttons, chips and fills — 'glossy / shiny / candy'. Separate from bevel (edge light); raise both for moulded 3D plastic. 0 = matte.

glowColor.description: Glow in an exact hue where the curated glow keys don't reach ('purple neon', a brand color). Wins over shape.glow when present, including over glow 'none'. Omit for the keyed glow.

decorationKey.description: Curated decoration key. Each maps to an inline SVG shipped with the engine — zero per-game payload cost. Prefer these over custom SVGs.

borderImageInline.description: Inline SVG used as a CSS border-image. Stretched or repeated along the element's border box.

svg.description: Inline SVG markup, ≤16kb. Use only when no curated decoration fits.

borderSlice.description: border-image-slice value: pixel offset that divides the SVG into 9-slice regions.

backgroundInline.description: Inline SVG used as a CSS background image. Sized, positioned, and tiled inside the element's content/pseudo-element box.

svg.description: Inline SVG markup, ≤16kb. Use only when no curated decoration fits.

size.description: background-size: cover | contain | auto, or an explicit tile size like "32px 32px". A REPEATING pattern needs the explicit form — these SVGs carry only a viewBox, so auto scales one copy over the whole element instead of tiling.

borderImageValue.description: Border-image decoration: curated key (preferred) or inline SVG with 9-slice controls.

backgroundValue.description: Background decoration: curated key (preferred) or inline SVG with size/position/repeat controls.

borderImage.description: Applied as border-image around the element box.

backdrop.description: Applied as a background behind the element's content.

decorationBefore.description: Renders via ::before — typically a flourish above/before the element.

decorationAfter.description: Renders via ::after — typically a flourish below/after the element (e.g. blood drips under a health bar).

decorations.description: Decoration slots keyed by HUD element class.

partialTheme.description: Subset of a theme used for per-element overrides. All fields optional; supplied values override the global theme for the matching element id.
